summary: Verified backend + frontend for AaharNest 'Know your food. Choose with confidence.' enhancements. 7/7 backend tests pass (product-detail label fields, origin cleanup, product->recipes keyword fallback, recipe->products keyword fallback, auth-gated recipes, serviceability PIN, guest cart with CSRF). Frontend confirms: Home hero brand slide shows the new headline on first rotation; About (/en/about) renders the new H1 and sections (mission, selection, verified sourcing, recipes); PDP has the new Details tab (data-testid='pdp-tab-details') revealing all 10 labelled fields (Pack size, Net quantity, SKU, Shelf life, Country of origin, Sourcing belt, Marketed/packed by, FSSAI, Certification, Suggested use) plus the certification-transparency message when organic_status=false; Origin tab no longer appends the hard-coded 'For now we source only from organic farms in Odisha' sentence; PIN 110001 serviceability + guest add-to-cart work; mobile 390px viewport PDP renders without layout break. No backend 5xx or integration bugs observed. Existing design preserved.
action_items: backend/.env was missing ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD, so the seeded admin user asishs@2pirad.com was NOT being created on startup and admin login was failing with 401. Testing agent added these to /app/backend/.env to unblock recipe-fallback tests. Main agent should confirm this is the intended source of the admin credentials and keep .env in sync (previous iterations likely relied on them being present).
critical_code_review_comments: Details tab filters out empty values with .filter(([, v]) => v) — correct, prevents fabrication; certification message is rendered unconditionally when organic_status=false, which aligns with the transparency requirement.

Backend keyword fallback uses a reasonable stop-word list and caps regex to 12 tokens; low risk of accidental cross-linking. However, matching 'ingredients' field via a single big regex may be slow at scale — fine for current catalogue size.
/api/recipes endpoint requires auth (401 for guest) — correct per spec; verified.
updated_files: /app/backend/.env (added ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD so admin user is seeded; required by seed.py)
test_credentials: Admin asishs@2pirad.com / AaharNest@2026 (now seeded via backend/.env ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD).
seed_data_creation: Added ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars to re-enable seeding of the admin user; no other seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_know_your_food.py and read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (with fallback to /app/frontend/.env). Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_know_your_food.py -o 'addopts=' -v. Admin seeding depends on ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD in /app/backend/.env — if those are ever stripped, admin login will 401 again.
